---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "Samuel Sammartano"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards_sf <- mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 46, 55), between(long, 7, 25)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world) +
  geom_sf(data = mallards_sf, aes(color = duck_id), size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS fixes in the region of interest",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Duck"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
